case_title: Recent shelf move but stable demand pattern
exception_description: Order WH-6338 needs 5 units of SKU MUG-24. WMS shows 14 units and the last count was 8 hours ago. The item was moved to a neighboring shelf during a minor location cleanup. AI recommends shipping from the current location.
layer1_visible: Order WH-6338 needs 5 units of SKU MUG-24. WMS shows 14 units and the last count was 8 hours ago. The item was moved to a neighboring shelf during a minor location cleanup. AI recommends shipping from the current location.
detail_expand: No demand spike, return backlog, or replenishment anomaly is recorded for this SKU. A reserve pallet is available, but using it requires an aisle crossing and later replenishment adjustment. The case looks slightly noisy, yet the underlying evidence still supports the AI plan once routine housekeeping is separated from true risk.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends shipping from the current location because the cleanup move appears already reflected in the WMS and reserve handling adds avoidable cost.
